tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan ngag gi rgyan gnyis so so'i dbye ba'i dper brjod bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshem dkar pad tshal las/ /legs 'khrungs ngang ba'i bu mo mtsho ldan ma/ /bdag yid pad mtshor dgyes dgur rol ba yis/ /rnal dpyod sbobs pa'i rlabs 'phreng g.yo bar mdzod/ /'dir snyan ngag gi rnam gzhag cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de yang me long mar le'u gsum 'byung ba'i phyi ma gnyis nas bshad pa'i don rgyan dang sgra rgyan kyi rtsa ba'i dpe brjod 'ga' zhig ni logs su bris pa ltar yin la/ 'dir rgyan gnyis so so'i dbye ba mtshon tsam de brjod par bya'o/ /de'i dang po don rgyan la so lnga yod pa'i thog ma ni rang bzhin gyi rgyan te/ 'di la dbye na bzhi'o/ /de gang zhe na/ rigs dang*/ bya ba dang/ yon tan dang*/ rdzas dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rtsa bar/ ne tso ni mchu mdog dmar zhing*/ dbyibs gug pa dang*/ gshogs pa ljang zhing mnyen pa dang*/ mgrin par dkar sngo dmar ba'i kha dog gsum ldan dang*/ tshig snyan par smra ba ste de lta bu'i rigs sam mtshan nyid can yin pas mtshon nas/ gzhan dag la'ang sbyor bar bshad de/ rang bzhin gang yin pa de la sgro ma btags par drang por brjod pa'o/ / dper mtshon na/ mthar yas tshogs gnyis dpal las 'khrungs ba'i sku/ / brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i nyams ldan gzhon nu'i tshul/ /dmar ser 'od phung phyogs bcur 'phro ba can/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i gter gyis rnam dpyod stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa bya ba ni/ /rtsa bar phu ron gyis rang gi mo la bskor nas 'dod pas mchu sbyor ba sogs kyi bya ba dang sbyar la/ 'dir mtshon na/ brtson pas mi pham mgon po legs bsgrubs pas/ /zhal gzigs yum don ma lus thugs chud de/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal sras thogs med blo gsal dga' ba bskyed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa yon tan ni/ rtsa bar bu med kyi lus la reg pa'i reg bya'i yon tan dang 'khrig pa'i bde ba thob pa dang sbyar la/

'dir/ pad zla'i gdan la zhabs zung skyil krung gis/ /rang rig phyag rgya mchog dang mnyam sbyar bas/ /zag med reg bya'i bde bas myos gyur pa/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas ni/ rtsa bar dbang phyug lag na rdzas rgyal mtshan dang thod pa 'dzin cing mgrin pa sngo ba sogs dang sbyar la/ 'dir/ sku mdog sngon po pad nyi'i gdan steng du/ /g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs stag sham smad dkris shing*/ / spyan gsum gser kyi rdo rje 'phyar stabs kyis/ /'dzin mdzad gnod sbyin dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /ces pa lta bu'o/ /༈ gnyis pa dpe rgyan la so gnyis yod de/ chos dpe/ dngos dpe/ bzlog pa'i dpe/ phan tshun gyi dpe/ nges pa'i dpe/ nges med kyi dpe/ bsdus pa'i dpe/ phul byung gi dpe/ rab brtags kyi dpe/ rmad byung gi dpe/ rmongs pa'i dpe/ the tshom gyi dpe/ gtan 'bebs kyi dpe/ sbyar ba'i dpe/ mnyam nyid kyi dpe/ smad pa'i dpe/ bsngags pa'i dpe/ brjod 'dod kyi dpe/ 'gal ba'-i dpe/ dgag pa'i dpe/ ngo bstod kyi dpe/ de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dpe/ 'byung min gyi dpe/ srid min gyi dpe/ mang ba'i dpe/ rnam 'gyur gyi dpe/ 'phreng ba'i dpe/ ngag don gyi dpe/ zla bo'o dngos dpe/ mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe/ rgyu'i dpe'o/ /'di dag rgyas par bshad na mang du dogs pas/ mtshon tsam re brjod na dang po chos dpe ni/ dpe chos kyi khyad par dngos su brjod pa zhig ste/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /'dzum pa'i zhal na bzhi bcu'i tshems/ /tshar du dngar ba nyi 'od kyis/ /'khyud pa'i gangs ri bzhin du dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu chos dpe gangs ri dkar ba nyid dngos su brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa dngos dpe ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi ngo bo tsam dngos su brjod nas mtshungs par sbyar zhing mtshungs chos gzhan gco bor ma brjod pa zhig ste/ dbyangs can lha mo'i zhal bzang 'di/

/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid dang mtshungs/ /spyan gnyis utpal sngon po yi/ /'dab ma rangs pa lta bur gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa bzlog pa'i dpe ni/ spyir dpes dpe can 'jal dgos pa la/ 'dir dpe las bzlog pa zhig ste/ /zhi 'dzum nyams ldan sgrol ma'i sku/ /ljang gsal 'od phung 'phro ba ltar/ /shin tu dag pa'i mar gad kyi/ /kha dog mdzes shing yid du 'ong*/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa phan tshun dpe ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis phan tshun mtshon pa zhig ste/ dbyangs can myos bum ji bzhin du/ /sprin dkar gzhon nu g.yo zhing mdzes/ /chu 'dzin gzhon nu bzhin du ni/ /dbyangs can khyod kyi nu ma yang*/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa nges pa'i dpe ni/ dpe dang dpe can 'dra ba de lta bu gzhan la med pa ltar brjod pa zhig ste/ tshe yi dngos grub stsol pa la/ /rnam rgyal ma nyid srid 'di na/ /tshe dpag med dang mtshungs mthong gi /rigs mthun gzhan zhig yod ma yin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa nges med kyi dpe ni/ dpe de 'dra gzhan la'ang yod par brjod pa zhig ste/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo dang mtshungs kyi/ /de 'dra gzhan zhig 'byung srid na/ /de yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs ltar bzung*/ /zhes lta bu'o/ /bdun pa bsdus pa'i dpe ni/ dpe dang mtshungs pa'i yon tan gzhan brjod rgyu yod pa zhig ste/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs/ /rje btsun rgyal ba gnyis pa dang*/ /zab don gzigs pa tsam gyis ni/ /mtshungs min rgyud don mkhyen pas kyang*/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /brgyad pa phul byung gi dpe ni/ /dpe dang dpe can gnyis khyad par cung zad tsam ma gtogs khyad 'phags 'dra bar brjod pa zhig ste/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter chen dang*/ /rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa'i zhabs/ /ral ba'i zur phud ldan mi ldan/ /ma gtogs tha dad brjod du med/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /dgu ba rab btags kyi dpe ni/

dpe la sems med kyang sems yod pa ltar byas nas brjod pa zhig ste/ rab dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /mdzes pa dbyangs can zhal nyid la/ /yod ces mi snyems kunda'i mdog /des kyang zhal gyi dpe zlar byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bcu ba rmad byung gi dpe ni/ dpe can de la dpe de dkon pa ltar ston pa zhig ste/ pad dkar 'dab ma rgyas pa la/ /'phrul gyi spyan dang zhal ldan na/ /dbyangs can zhal gyi dpal 'dzin gyi/ /gzhan na de yi dper 'os dkon/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gcig pa rmongs dpe ni/ dpe can dpe dang 'dra bas shan ma phyed pa ltar brjod pa zhig ste/ thub dbang nam mkhar gshegs pa na/ kha cig ngang pa'i rgyal po zhig /lha lam yangs pa'i ngos nyid du/ /rgyu 'dra snyam nas mkha' la lta/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gnyis pa the tshom gyi dpe ni/ phyogs 'dir thub bstan srol 'dzin par/ /rje btsun zur phud lnga ldan nam/ /rgyal ba gnyis pas rjes bzung zhig /byon nam snyam pa'i som nyir gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gsum pa gtan 'bebs ni/ dpe gzhan zhig dang 'dra yang de de min par nges nas brjod pa zhig ste/ snyan tshig smra ba'i slob dpon 'di/ /paṇa chen daṇḍi dang mtshungs kyang*/ /yul 'dir snyan ngag gzhung ston phyir/ /kirti'i mtshan can nyid du nges/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba ni/ sbyor rgyu gnyis las mi nyung zhing mtshungs pa ston pa zhig ste/ phun tshogs legs pa'i dpal ster zhing*/ /phongs ba kun gyi dgrar gyur pa/ /shin tu rnyed dka' sras gtsang sras/ yid bzhin nor dang yang dag mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / bco lnga pa mnyam pa nyid ni/ tshig gang gis dpe dang dpe can gnyis gzhan las rgyal tshul mnyam pa nyid du brjod pa lta bu zhig ste/ bdud bzhi'i dpung bcom rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun las rgyal ba'i khyab 'jug dang*/ /sngon gyi lha rnams las rgyal ba/ /lha yi dbang po brgya byin bzhin/

/zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu drug pa smad pa ni/ chos mtshungs yod kyang dpe dpe can las cung zad smad nas brjod pa zhig ste/ tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs zab don bral/ /rnga gsang brjod bya'i don gyis stong*/ thub pa'i yan lag drug cu'i gsung*/ /zab rgyas don ldan khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu bdun pa bsngags pa ni/ yon tan gyi sgo nas brjod pa zhig ste/ phas rgol dngos stobs rigs pa yis/ /tshar gcod pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung*/ /gsal mdzad rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa nyid dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bco brgyad pa brjod 'dod ni/ skyon yon ji ltar yang dpe dang dpe can mtshungs par ston pa lta bu zhig ste/ yid 'ong dga' ma khyod kyi bzhin/ /ra ri'i dri mas ma gos sam/ /gos kyang zla ba shar pa ltar/ /bdag gi yid la dga' ba 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu dgu pa 'gal ba ni/ /mkhas pa 'dra yang rten 'gal bar ston pa lta bu zhig ste/ smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ngag dbang lha mor dbyangs can ma/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs/ /mkhas par mtshungs kyang rten nyid 'gal/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyi shu pa dgag pa ni/ /dgag bya 'gog pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa zhig ste/ ri bong mtshan ma'i skyon ldan cing*/ /'phel 'grib cha shas bcas pa'i zla/ /dkar yang rje btsun mtsho byung ma'i/ /zhal gyi khyim dang ci ltar mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer gcig pa ngo bstod kyi dpe ni/ /dpe can las dpe cung zad lhag rgyu yin pa la 'dra bar ston pa zhig ste/ dbyangs can zhal gyi zla mdangs 'dzin/ /gny-is skyes dbang po zla ba dngos/ /'on te bdag gi gzugs 'dzin ngos/ /dkar zhing 'tsher la khyad ma mchis/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer gnyis pa de nyid brjod pa ni/ /dpe can dpe ru ma nor bar brjod pa zhig ste/ rnam par bkra ba'i dbang gzhu dang*/ /'dra yang de min lha rdzas dang*/ /snyan 'gyur rgyud mangs sgra 'dra yang*/

/ma yin gling bu nyid kyi sgra/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ dpe gzhan dkon pas rang nyid dper brjod pa zhig ste/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /chos kun gzigs pa'i dpe ru gzhan/ /ma rnyed rang nyid dpe ru bstan/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer bzhi pa 'byung min ni/ /rgyal ba'i mdo sngags chos tshul kun/ /'dzin mdzad blo bzang grags pa dang*/ / mtshungs pa 'byung min 'byung srid na/ /de nyid de yi dpe zlar 'os/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer lnga pa srid min ni/ /me las chu dang de las me/ tsandan tshal las dri ngan bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i yul 'das pa'i/ /shes bya nam mkha'i padmo bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer drug pa mang ba ni/ dpe mang po zhig gis dpe can gyi khyad par gsal ba zhig ste/ gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs tshad dang*/ /lha yi lam mtha' rdul gyi grangs/ /ji bzhin tshogs gnyis bsags pa las/ /dpag yas yon tan ldan thob 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer bdun pa rnam 'gyur ni/ / dpe can de dpe zhig gi gnas nas byung ba ltar ston pa zhig ste/ mdzes ma khyod bzhin zla ba dang*/ /padma'i nang nas phyung ba bzhin/ /yan lag sor mo'i lcugs phran ni/ /ljon shing gzhon las skyes pa bzhin/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer brgyad pa phreng ba ni/ /snga ma snga ma dpe dang phyi ma phyi ma dpe can du bkod pa zhig ste/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad tshal bzhin/ /padma'i tshal gyis mtsho la bzhin/ /dag pa'i mkha' la zla ba bzhin/ /des kyang kunda'i tshal la bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / nyer dgu pa ngag don ni/ dpes dpe can gyi khyad chos rim par go bar byed pa zhig ste/ 'di la bzhin sgra gcig pa dang*/ bzhin sgra du ma yod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'jam dkar g.yas pa'i phyag sor rtser/ /utpal steng na ral gri ni/ /gangs ri'i rtse na nyi 'od kyis/ /'khyud pa'i g.yu sdong ldem bzhin

gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gser gyi lhun bzhin rgyal ba'i sku/ /nyi mdangs gsal bzhin 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rlung gis mi bskyod ri bzhin du/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis g.yo mi nus/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /sum cu pa zla bo'i dngos dpe ni/ dpe dang dpe can dkon tshul don mnyam par brjod pa zhig ste/ bod du mkhas grub mang byon yang*/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i do zla med/ /ri rab rtse na lha mang dbus/ /mig stong ldan 'dra srid ma yin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /so gcig pa mtshungs sbyor ni/ dpe dang dpe can la mchog dman yod kyang mtshungs par sbyar nas ston pa zhig ste/ thub dbang srid gsum ston pa dang*/ /dbang phyug mu stegs ston pa ste/ /rgyal bas nges legs lam ston bzhin/ /mgrin sngon sgra dang gtan tshigs ston/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /so gnyis pa rgyu'i dpe rgyan ni/ dpe can mdzes pa sogs kyi khyad chos 'gas dpe khyad par can gyi rjes su 'gro bar ston pa zhig ste/ dbyangs can zhal dkar zla rjes 'gro/ /spyan gnyis utpal sngon po dang*/ /smin 'khyog dbang po'i gzhu yi zla/ /tshems dkar dung gi rjes 'gro byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /'dir skyon yon ngos 'dzin tshul dang mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi dbye ba zhig bshad pa ni mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ / ༈ gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan la nyi shu yod de/ de yang bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ de bzhin du bsdus shing ma bsdus pa/ mtha' dag gzugs can/ cha shas kyi/ cha shas can gyi/ yan lag gcig pa'i/ ldan pa'i/ mi ldan pa'i/ mi mnyam pa'i/ khyad par dang bcas pa'i/ 'gal ba'i/ rgyu'i/ sbyar ba'i/ dpe'i/ ldog pa'i/ 'gog pa'i/ mnyam 'jog gi gzugs can gyi/ bsnyon dor kyi gzugs can no/ /'di rnams 'grel ba dang bstun nas tshig bsdus te brjod par bya zhing*/ dang po bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis khyad gzhi khyad chos sbyar nas rnam dbye drug pa rnams bsdus pa zhig ste/

khyed sku kun gsal yangs ngos su/ /thags bzang sprin dkar 'phreng 'khrigs shing*/ /gsung dbyangs dbyar rnga sgrogs mdzad pas/ /skal ldan mdongs can gar gyis brel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ma bsdus pa ni/ khyad gzhi khyad chos sbyar nas rnam dbye drug pa ma bsdus pa zhig ste/ 'jam dkar sku yi ri dbang la/ /lang tsho'i nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'khyud/ /mdzes sdug 'gying ba'i bang rim can/ /spangs rtogs mi 'gyur brtan pa nyid/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa bsdus shing ma bsdus pa ni/ rnam dbye drug pa bsdus ma bsdus gnyis ka yod pa ste/ lang tsho'i dbyibs kyi dpal mo las/ /zhal khyim pad mo 'dab g.yo zhing*/ /gsung snyan bung ba'i sgra ldan pa/ /dbyangs can sku yi pad sdong ldem/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa mthar dag gzugs can ni/ dpe dang dpe can rnams gcig la yod cing gcig la med pa ma yin par mtha' dag gzugs su bkod pa zhig ste/ phyag zung yal 'dab rgyas pa'i rtsair/ /sor mo'i lcugs phran ldem zhing g.yo/ /pi wang sngon po'i 'dab ma can/ /gang sku dpag sam ljon shing mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa cha shas gzugs can ni/ /cha can dpe'i gzugs su ma bkod cing cha shas der bkod pa zhig ste/ mang thos ral pa'i 'khur gyis brjid/ /lung dang rigs pa'i lus stobs rgyas/ /gzhung lugs gangs ri'i spor gnas pa/ /rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen ces grags/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa cha shas can ni/ cha can gzugs su bkod cing cha shas khyad par pa rnams der ma bkod pa zhig ste/ 'jam dbyangs bzhin gyi mkha' ngos su/ /khams gsum gzigs pa'i spyan g.yo shing*/ /tshems dkar mdzes pa'i zhal sgo las/ /dam chos 'doms pas dga' ba bskyed/ / ces pa lta bu'o/ /bdun pa yan lag gcig pa ni/ cha shas sam yan lag gcig pa zhig gzugs su bkod cing cha can dang cha shas gzhan mang po der ma bkod pa zhig ste/ ston pa mchog des zhing 'di ru/

/tshangs dbyangs gsung gis gdul bya rnams/ /mngon mtho nges legs la 'god pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /brgyad pa ldan pa ni/ dpe can cha can dang cha shas su ldan par ma zad dpe yang de ltar ldan par ston pa zhig ste/ dbyangs can phyag zung ljon pa'i rtser/ /pi wang khu byug skad snyan sgrog /'dam skyes pad tshal 'dab ma'i dbus/ /bung ba phur lding sgra snyan sgrog /ces pa lta bu'o/ /dgu pa mi ldan pa ni/ sngar ltar mi ldan par brjod pa zhig ste/ mchu sgros pad dkar 'dab ma'i dbus/ /ljags kyi klog 'phreng rnam par 'khyug /rnam bkra'i dbang po'i gzhu yi spyan/ /bzhin ras zla ba'i ngos na zug /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bcu pa mi mnyam pa ni/ yan lag can dang yan lag nges med du 'ga' zhig gzugs su byas la 'ga' zhig der ma byas pa zhig ste/ gsung dbyangs rna bar rab snyan cing*/ /tshems dkar ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan pa/ /dbyangs can sku yi pad tshal ni/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi 'byung ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gcig pa khyad par dang bcas pa ni/ yon tan gyi khyad par 'gas 'ga' zhig la 'jig pa med cing gzhan la dga' bar byed pa'i khyad par ston pa zhig ste/ /rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo yis/ /mkhyen pa'i ral gri mkhar 'phyar tshe/ /phas rgol dgra sde'i 'jigs med cing*/ /blo gros can dag dga' ba rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gnyis pa 'gal ba'i gzugs ni/ dpe can gyis dpe'i bya ba mi 'dra ba'i bya ba zhig byed par ston pa lta bu ste/ /dbyangs can sred ldan g.yon mig mas/ /nyon mongs 'phel bar mi byed cing*/ /'khrig pa'i bde ba mi ster bar/ /chags bral 'phags pa'i lam la 'khrid/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs ni/ zab brling sogs kyi rgyu brjod pa dang sbyar ba zhig ste/ 'jam dbyangs rmongs mun sel bas zla/ /zab don mkhyen pas nyi ma dang*/ / legs bshad 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas te/

/thar ba'i grong 'khrid ded dpon mchog /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bcu bzhi ba sbyar ba'i gzugs ni/ dpe brjod pa'i sgo nas don dang sbyar nas bsdus pa zhig ste/ thub pa'i gsung gi rdzing bu la/ / gnyis skyes tshogs kyis longs spyod cing*/ /dri ma 'khrud phyir 'bad pa yis/ /'jug pa'i ngal ba bsten par byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bco lnga pa dpe'i gzugs ni/ /dpe can de dpe dang mtshungs par brjod pa zhig ste/ sked skabs phra ldem dpag bsam shing*/ /yan lag 'dab ma rab tu g.yo/ /'dod ba'i re skong dbyangs can zhabs/ /yongs 'du nor bu nyid dang 'ang mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu drug pa ldog pa can ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis chos mtshungs pa las ldog nas brjod pa zhig ste/ ri dwags dra ba'i rgyar chud pa/ /rno ba'i mtshon gyis gcod nus kyi/ /'dod sred 'ching bas bcings ba'i rgya/ /mtshon gyis gcod ba'i nus pas dben/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu bdun pa 'gog pa ni/ khyod bzhin zla ba'i mdzes pa 'dis/ /bdag yid mtsho la bsil ba'i dpal/ /sbyin las ma yin 'dod pa'i gdung*/ /ster 'dis zla ba ga la zhig / ces pa lta bu'o/ /bco brgyad mnyam 'jog ni/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis ka la skyon mnyam par ston pa zhig ste/ rtogs dka'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho la/ /blo chung ri bong brgal dka' bas/ /ha cang zab cing rgya che'i mtshor/ /mi 'os 'jug pa 'dis kyang nongs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bcu dgu pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can ni/ gzugs can du sbyar nas dpe can la dpe 'phar ma bkod pa zhig ste/ gzugs sku'i gangs ri'i dga' tshal du/ /mtshan dpe'i chu klung 'khyil ba las/ /phan bde'i bsil ngad dga' ston gyis/ /las ldan sdug bsngal tsha gdung sel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyi shu pa bsnyon dor can ni/ gzhi de la de ma yin no zhes bsnyon te bzlog nas brjod pa zhig ste/ mkha' yi gos dkar chu 'dzin 'di/ /de min lha rdzas yol ba ste/

/rab snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang yang*/ /'brug sgra min gyi tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan la gnas gsum gyi gsal byed/ 'phreng ba'i gsal byed/ 'gal don gyi gsal byed/ don gcig gi gsal byed/ sbyar ba'i gsal byed dang lnga'o/ /dang po la dbye ba'i sgo nas rigs sogs bzhi la gnas nges pa'i sgo nas gsum du bstan pa la dbye ba brgyad yod pa'i rigs brjod pa'i thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ ne tsos skad snyan sgrog byed cing*/ /mchu gug ljang mdog gshog sgro ngom/ kha dog gsum ldan mgrin pa yis/ /byis pa dag la dga' ba skyed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa bya ba brjod pa'i thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ sbyin no rgyal bas dam pa'i chos/ /tshangs pa'i bu mos ngag gi dpal/ /brtan pa'i 'khor los blo gros mchog /'dzam las nor gyi dngos grub kyang*/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa yon tan brjod pa'i thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ gsal lo mkha' la nyi ma dang*/ /chu gter dbus na rgyu skar zla/ /me long ngos su byad bzhin gzugs/ /mkhas mang dbus na rje bla ma/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa rdzas brjod pa'i thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ ri bong rtags mtshan zla ba yis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon yangs gsal byed cing*/ /mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa dang*/ /skye bo du ma yid dga' byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa rigs brjod pa'i bar gyi gsal byed ni/ /tshogs gnyis mtha' dag yongs rdzogs shing*/ /sgrib gnyis spangs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ris med 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /brtse ba'i thugs rje chen po ldan/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa bya ba brjod pa'i bar gyi gsal byed ni/ don gnyer can la legs bshad dang*/ / phongs pa dag la zas nor gyis/ /dga' bar byed do 'dod ldan la/ /lang tsho dar ba'i lus phra mas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bdun pa rigs brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed ni/ sku mdog dmar ser gzhon nu'i tshul/

/g.yas g.yon ral gri glegs bam 'dzin/ /zur phud lnga ldan blo yi mchog /legs par ster mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / brgyad pa bya ba brjod pa'i tha ma'i gsal byed ni/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis padmo'i tshal/ /ri bong can gyis kunda'i kha/ /gtan tshigs rigs pas blo yi sgo/ /tshul 'dis ngag gi sgo 'phar 'byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa 'phreng ba'i gsal byed ni/ dag pa'i mkha' zla ba dang*/ /des kyang kunda'i tshal nyid la/ /dang ba'i mtsho ba 'dab brgya pa/ /des kyang mdzes ma'i thod la'o/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa 'gal don gyi gsal byed ni/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis grang ba yi/ /gdung ba ma lus sel ba dang*/ /myu gu sngon po skem 'gyur ba'i/ /bya ba mi 'dra rnam gnyis byed/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa mang po don gcig gi gsal byed ni/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i smin legs ma/ /nu 'bur g.yo zhing smin ma 'khyog /mchu sgros dmar zhing so phreng dkar/ /'dod ldan snying la gdung ba ster/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa sbyar ba'i gsal byed ni don gnyis 'dra bar sbyar ba ste/ /stong nyid smra ba'i spobs mtho zhing*/ /mdo sngags gzhung kun 'chad pa la/ /'jal dbyangs rgyal ba'i mdun sa dang*/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa zhing 'di'i rgyan/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ lnga pa skor ba'i rgyan la gsum ste/ don dang tshig dang de gnyis ka la skor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched/ /thub pa'i bstan la rab zhugs nas/ /ston pa'i lung rtogs dam pa'i chos/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dgongs bzhin bzung*/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ gnyis pa ni/ nyi mas padmo'i tshal rab rgyas/ /zla bas utpal 'dab ma rgyas/ /rgyal bas 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas/ / dbyangs can lha mos sgra don rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dam chos yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /dge 'dun yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /mchod pa'i yaun tan bsam mi khyab/

/ces pa lta bu'o/ / shugs bstan yi ge la skor ba ni/ nga dang nga 'dra nga rgyal mtho/ kha gcig kha dog kha na ngoms/ la la la lung la sogs 'khyam/ /za sbyang za ma za la spro/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan la nyer gsum yod pa las/ dang po 'das pa 'gog pa ni/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyis bden bzhi'i chos/ /bstan pa tsam gyis grol 'di ci/ /'on kyang srid pa tha ma yi/ /rang bzhin so skyes tshad du dka'/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa da ltar ba 'gog pa ni/ /g.yas g.yon phyag tu glegs ral gnyis/ /'dzin la dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kun kyang*/ mngon gzigs mkhyen mchog 'dis lhag gang*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /gsum pa ma 'ongs pa 'gog pa ni/ mngon mtho'i rgyu bzang tshul khrims mchog /srung ba'i tshul las 'da' byed na/ /phyi ma ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa ru/ /ltung phyir 'jug pa gdon mi za/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa chos 'gog pa ni/ lus phra khyod bzhin zla ba ni/ /bsil pa nyid ces grags 'di brdzun/ /bden na glo bur sred ldan la/ /'dod pa'i tsha gdung skyed 'di ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa chos can 'gog pa ni/ gang tshe ston pas cho 'phrul che/ /ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul de nyid/ /kho bas lo rgyus dag las ni/ /thos pa tsam ste mngon mthong min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa rgyu 'gog pa ni/ gzu bor mi gnas phyogs lhung can/ /'ga' yis thos bsam byed pa'i tshe/ /'phya smod byed kyang de yi rgyu/ /med phyir tshul der ga la zhum/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bdun pa 'bras bu 'gog pa ni/ yid srub bu mo 'dzes ma yis/ /rgyal sras drung du 'jo sgegs kyi/ /rnam 'gyur mang bstan glags btsal kyang*/ /nyon mongs bral phyir glags ma rnyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ brgyad pa rjes gnang gis 'gog pa ni/ /nyin byed dbang khyod nub phyogs kyi/ /sa 'dzin brgal bar 'dod na mdzod/ /'on kyang chu skyes 'dab ma rnams/ /zum zhing bdag gis gzugs mi mthong*/

/zhes pa lta bu/ dgu ba dbang gis 'gog pa ni/ 'od dkar can khyod gling gzhan du/ /gshegs na phyogs de'i mun sel yang*/ /rang cag gnas pa'i gling 'di ru/ /snang ba gsal phyir 'dug par rigs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /bcu pa ma gus pas 'gog pa ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rjes 'jug khyod/ /mgon de'i chos tshul bzung na legs/ /rang mos grub mtha' thams cad la/ /'jug na rang gi gang mos gyis/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /bcu gcig pa shis brjod kyis 'gog pa ni/ /tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur ched tsam du/ / 'jug na de don 'grub par shog /phyi ma sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur ba/ /shes tshe 'gyod par ma byed cig /ces pa lta bu/ bcu gnyis pa rtsub chos 'gog pa ni/ gal te khyod ni log g.yem la/ /'gro bar 'dod na de ltar gyis/ /phyi ma'i tshe na mnar med du/ /song na de tshe 'gyod mi 'tshal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu gsum pa grogs kyis 'gog pa ni/ rje khyod tshong la gshegs na bzhung*/ /ring du thogs na phyi shul gyi/ /grogs dang nye du gzhan pa rnams/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal thob tu mchi/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu bzhi pa 'bad pas 'gog pa ni/ spang ljong mdzes pas legs bstar ba'i/ /gnas su dga' ston la rol tshe/ /nyin byed chu lha'i rir nye bar/ /mthong tshe rings pa'i tshig brjod thal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bco lnga pa gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa ni/ khyod kyis bya ba de lta bu/ /byed na nged la dris pas ci/ /rje bo nyid la dris shig dang*/ /gnang na bdag kyang de ltar 'dod/ / bcu drug pa thabs kyis 'gog pa ni/ rje khyod ri khrod bsten byed na/ /legs mod bdag cag nye grogs kun/ /zas gos nor gyis mi phongs pa'i/ /'byor ldan mi zad thabs nyid mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu/ bcu bdun pa khro bas 'gog pa ni/ thos pa'i grwar zhugs ma 'bad na/ /ci yang mi shes ma bslabs pa'i/ /grong pa'i skye bo gzhan dag dang*/ /mtshungs pa nyid du cis mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta

bu/ /bco brgyad pa mya ngan gyis 'gog pa ni/ /gzhan don 'dod chung bsten pa'i ched/ /bsod nams rgyu bar rigs mod kyi/ /gzhan du srang mdor sbrang 'khyam dang*/ /lhan cig gnas la dgos pa ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu dgu 'gyod pas 'gog pa ni/ mi bzad ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma bsam shing*/ /byang sems lta bas ma zin par/ /ri 'dabs mi tshe yol kyang ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyi shu pa the tshom gyis 'gog pa ni/ gang 'di dbu tshad rig gnas la/ /sbyangs pa'i bla chen mkhas pa'am/ /yang na rang bzhin mkhas dbang zhig /yin gyi tha mal blun po min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gcig pa sbyar bas 'gog pa ni/ mkhas mchog klu rgyal gtsug na 'dzin/ /bde legs 'dod dgu ster mdzad pa'i/ /thub pa dbang rgyal mchis bzhin du/ /nor bu phal pa gzhan gyis ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gnyis pa don gzhan 'gog pa ni/ rgyal bas ris bral 'gro rnams la/ /dam chos mnyam du bstan pas ci/ /lha klus ris med char pham kyang*/ /sa bon rung smin mi rung min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gsum pa rgyus 'gog pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag cag gis/ /blo gros 'phel phyir gsol btab ste/ /'on kyang shes rab stsom pa'i lha/ /yin phyir gsol 'debs ci la bltos/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa la brgyad las/ dang po kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa ni/ tshangs pas thig le mchog ma la/ /chags pas bltas zhes su yis smad/ /sred ldan 'gro ba 'di kun kyang*/ /'dod pas gzir ba rang bzhin nyid/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ thub ba'i 'phrin las thugs rje yis/ /theg gsum gdul bya'i yon tan rgyas/ /rta bdun can gyi 'od zer gyis/ /padmo'i smin pa'i 'dab ma rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa sbyar ba'i don gzhan ni/ gdul bya'i gtsug na rgyal ba nyid/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar/

/lha yi rgyal po lha rnams kyi/ /gtsug gi ral pa'i rtse na 'gying*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa 'gal ba'i don gzhan ni/ mdzes sdug dga' bskyed dbyangs can ma/ /zag med ye shes bde ba ster/ /lang tsho yol ba'i mkhas pa yis/ /blo ldan yid la dga' ba skyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ lnga pa mi 'os pa'i don gzhan ni/ mkhas dbang legs bshad nyi 'od kyis/ /phyogs lhung yid la zug rngu skyed/ /dad ldan gla rtsi'i dri tshor bas/ /dug sbrul dag la gnod par 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa 'os pa'-i don gzhan ni/ rgyal bas 'gro la chos bstan pas/ /phan dang bde ba'i legs tshogs rgyas/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na/ /pad dkar 'dab ma ci yang 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bdun pa 'os pa dang mi 'os pa'i don gzhan ni/ legs bshad dag la mkhas dga' yi/ /blun po'i tshogs ni de lta min/ /rab snyan sgra la thos 'dzin ldan/ /nyan gyi 'on pa dag gis min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ brgyad pa mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ sbyangs bas nyes bshad ston srid na/ /ma sbyangs blun gtam cis mi zair/ /legs bshad mkhas las 'byung dgos kyi/ /thos med blun gtam chos nyid yin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ brgyad pa ldog pa'i rgyan la sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa/ rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa/ 'byed byed mtshungs pa'i ldog pa/ rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa dang bzhi/ dang po la lnga las/ dang po gcig gi ldog pa can ni/ lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung zhing*/ /mkhas shing grub brnyes zla grags dang*/ /tsand+ra go mi mtshungs gyur kyang*/ /rab byung yin min rten gyis dbye/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa gnyis kyi ldog pa can ni/ thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen gnyis/ /gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad mtshungs kyang*/ /thub pa sprul sku'i rnam pa dang*/ /ci shos longs sku'i rnam pa can/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa sbyar ba'i ldog pa can ni/ mtsho byung zla ba'i gtsug rgyan can/

/'grub la dbyangs can bzhad pa dang*/ /saṅga ā tsarya mtshungs kyang*/ /snga ma nang ba gzhan ni ldog / ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa 'gog pa can gyi ldog pa ni/ skyabs mdzad 'dod pa'i re ba stsol/ /yid du 'ong zhing bsngags pa'i gnas/ /ngag gi yan lag cha rdzogs pas/ /dbyangs can yongs 'dus 'gran du ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can ni/ /sdod bu lo 'dab ze'u 'bru sogs/ /lnga yang skyaid med 'gram chang gis/ /kha nyid 'byed phyir ba ku la/ /padma gzhan dang khyad par che/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rje bla ma/ /zab don gzigs pa'i ye shes can/ /'on te 'jam dbyangs longs sku dang*/ /ci shos rab byung cha byad can/ /zhes pa lta bu ste chos mtshungs shugs la bstan pa'o/ /gsum pa 'phyed byed mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can ni/ gzhan phan rgyal tshab byams mgon dang*/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma btsong kha pa/ /snga ma dga' ldan lha yi rgyan/ /gzhan ni gangs can mkhas pa'i dpal/ /zhes pa lta bu ste 'di yang mtshungs pa shugs la 'phangs pa'o/ /bzhi pa rigs mthun ldog pa can ni/ rmongs pa'i ma rig mun pa dang*/ /mun khung byung ba'i mun nag gnyis/ /rigs mthun 'on te snga ma nyid/ /mar mes mi sel phyi ma sel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan la gsum las/ dang po ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ smra byed lce bral ca co sgrog /rkang bzhon med par rgyun du 'gro/ /gnod sems med par rgyu lam gcod/ /kha dog ma sgyur mdog sngo chu/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa 'bras bu rgyu cung zad dang bcas par brjod pa'i srid pa can ni/ phrog min thos pa'i nor gyis phyug /'tshe med rmongs pa'i dgra tshogs 'joms/ /'dod bral yon tan tshogs kyis 'khyud/ /dbyu gus ma skul skad snyan ldir/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa grags ma grags kyi rgyu bzlog nas 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyis srid par ston pa ni/

ma bris ri bong mtshan ma mdzes/ /gnod sems med par mun tshogs 'joms/ /'ded mkhan med kyang nub phyogs 'bros/ /bzo bcos ma byas 'phel 'grib ston/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / ༈ bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la spyi dang byed brag gnyis kyi dang po ni/ dpag bsam ljon pa'i grib bsil la/ /spyod pa'i dga' ston yongs bor nas/ /yal ga 'khyog po'i shing sgam la/ /skyabs 'cha' blun po 'di dag rmongs/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po khyad gzhi tha dad cing khyad chos mtshungs pa ni/ zab yangs gting mtha' rtogs dka' zhing*/ /re skong nor bu'i 'byung gnas mchog /dus su rab g.yo gdung sel can/ /dri ma'i skyon rnams 'khyud par byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs shing mi mtshungs pa ni/ 'jam zhing yid 'ong mdzes sdug ldan/ /yal 'dab ze'u 'bru g.yo ldem pa/ /chu skyes dkar po'i chun po 'di/ /rkang drug dag gi yid tshim byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa sngon med bsdus brjod ni/ nam mkha'i dbyings su mi rgyu zhing*/ /'phel 'grib cha shas mi ldan pa'i/ /sngon med zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bdag gi yid la ci yang sman/ /zhes pa lta bu ste mtshungs chos bsdus pa'o/ /༈ bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan la bzhi las/ dang po khyad 'phags phul byung ni/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /mthar phyin blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde/ /snyan ngag gzhung brgya smra ba la/ /dbyangs can mas kyang 'gran nus min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa the tshom phul byung ni/ nyin mtshan kun du thos bsam la/ /'bad pas 'jug cing sgrub brtson khyod/ /rang lus 'tsho ba'i bza' btung yang*/ /spyod skabs yod med 'phyang mo nyug /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa nges pa phul byung ni/ rtag tu thos bsam sgom pa dang*/ /kha ton tshul la rab 'bad pa/ /rgyun chad med kyang nyal gnyid tshe/ /bar skabs yod pa'i nges pa

brnyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ngo mtshar phul byung ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma btsong kha pa'i/ /mkhyen pa'i pha mtha' nam mkhas kyang*/ /mtshon min bod yul ljongs nyid du/ /shong gyur de ni e ma mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu ste mtshon tsam mo/ /'di la spro bar byas na dpe rgyan ltar so gnyis 'byung bar bshad do/ /༈ bcu gnyis pa rab rtog gi rgyan la gsum las/ dang po sems ldan rab rtog ni/ dbyangs can ral pa'i thor cog rtser/ /tshes pa'i zla bas brgyan pa ni/ /yar mar ngo'i mun pa'i tshogs/ /sel bar byed pa'i ched du dgongs/ / zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa sems med rab rtog ni/ rab mdzes tshes pa'i zla ba ni/ /spyi gtsug brgyan pa'i phyir 'ongs shing*/ /snyan gong utpal sngon po yang*/ /spyan dkyus ring la 'gran phyir 'ongs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rab rtog ni/ zla ba shar tshe kunda'i tshal/ /dga' bas 'dzum mul lta ba bzhin/ /bung bas bcud rnams 'khyer dogs nas/ /ge sar skrag nas 'dar ba bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /skabs 'di'i bzhin zhes pa ni dpe min no/ /༈ bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan la gsum las/ dang po dngos po'i rgyu la byed pa'i rgyu dang shes byed kyi rgyu gnyis/ dang po la sgrub byed dang las kyi rgyu gnyis/ dang po la 'grub byed dang nyams pa'i rgyu gnyis la/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /byin rlabs rjes su bzung ba'i mthus/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros kyi/ /snang ba yar ngo'i zla lhar 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa nyams byed kyi rgyu ni/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i/ /mkhyen rab nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis/ /don gnyer blo gsal tshogs rnams kyi/ /rmongs ba'i mun pa sel bar byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa las kyi rgyu ni/ sor mo'i 'khrul dang blo rtsal las/ /rgyal pa'i sku brnyan rab mdzes pa/ /dad ldan skye bo mtha' dag gi/ bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du gyur/

/ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po phyi'i shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ skya rengs tha ma shar gyur cing*/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyi bkod pa mthong*/ /'dab chags mang pos skad snyan sgrogs/ / gnyid kyang sad pas dus la bab/ /ces pa lta bu ste nam langs shing nyin mo 'byung ba'i shes byed do/ /gnyis pa nang gi shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ dka' gnad gzhung don dris pa'i tshe/ /'dzum dang bcas te lhug par smra/ /mang thos mkhas pa 'dus pa na/ /'jigs med chos kyi khri la 'gying*/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ /yon tan yod pa'i rtags sam shes byed do/ /de bzhin du/ chos gtam byas tshe ngo 'dzum nag /bza' btung mthong tshe 'dzum mul byed/ /ces sogs blun rtags kyang go'o/ /gnyis pa dngos med kyi rgyu la rgyu med pas 'bras bu yod pa bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu med pa bskyed pa gnyis/ dang po la bzhi las snga na med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ stobs ldan dpon la ma brten cing*/ /'byor can sbyin bdag ma bsdus kyang*/ /zang zing yo byad nyer mkho kun/ /'bad pa med par ngang gis 'dus/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa zhig nas med pa'i rgyu ni/ /chung nas bzung ba'i 'don cha brjed/ /ngo tsha khrel yod tshul yang 'grib/ /drin ldan slob dpon pha ma yang*/ /mi dran rang dgar spyod pa mthong*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ zla 'di lus phra'i gdong ma yin/ /ri bong rtags mtshan mig sna min/ /bsil ba rngul gyi thigs min pas/ /gnyis skyes rnams kyis bkur ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa spangs nas med pa'i rgyu ni/ ma dad le lo spangs byas te/ /dbyangs can sgom bzlas la brtson pas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul kun dang*/ /snyan ngag smra ba'i spobs pa thob/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa rgyu med pas 'bras bu med pa bskyed pa'i byed rgyu ni/ log lta ma dad med gyur na/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i mchog thun gyi/

/dngos grub dus skabs dang mtshungs pa/ /ci ltar rigs par 'thob 'gyur nges/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa mtshar ba'i rgyu la lnga las/ dang po ring 'bras kyi rgyu ni/ 'jam dbyangs rje btsun btsong kha pas/ /ci yang yid la mi byed pa'i/ /lta ngan dmigs phug bkag mdzad pas/ /lta log gzhan kun rim gyis ldog /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa ni/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba dang*/ /lhan cig pad tshal 'dzum byas shing*/ /mun pa sel dang lhan cig tu/ /gzugs rnams gsal bar mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa 'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu ni/ 'dod ldan g.yel ba'i gzhon nu 'gas/ /smin legs lus phra mar spyad de/ /slar yang mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur la/ /sred pa drag po ci yang 'byung*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa rigs min gyi rgyu ni/ phyi rol gzugs kyi bkod pa rnams/ /mthong byed nyi ma shar gyur bas/ /'byung po'i bya tshogs mig ldan yang*/ /gzugs kyi bkod pa mthong min mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa rigs pa'i rgyu ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug grub pa yi/ /tshangs sras lha mo ring bsten pas/ /snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra nus pa'i/ /ngag gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po zur gyi phra mo ni/ dbang phyogs sa 'dzin rtse mo nas/ /tshes pa'i zla ba shar mthong tshe/ /rig byed smra ba'i skyes bu 'ga'/ /lag song padmo snying khar sbyor/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa rnam pa'i phra mo ni/ mu stegs byed 'gas thub dbang la/ /gshe zhing skyon brjod ngan smras kyang*/ /zhal 'dzum tshems dkar nyer bstan pas/ /dad ldan yid la dga' ba 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu ste 'dis ston pa la bzod pa chen po ldan par ston no/ /༈ bco lnga pa cha'i rgyan la dngos po gsal bo zol gyis sbed pa'i cha dang*/ zol gyis smod cing bstod pa'i cha gnyis/ dang po la gnyis las/ dang po 'os pa'i cha ni/

rang gi 'byor ba rgyas pa'i ched/ /rnam sras bsgom la brtson pa'i tshe/ /phyi ma'i don du sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob phyir zab don sgom zhes smra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa mi 'os pa'i cha'i rgyan ni/ lto gos ched 'bad lus rngul tshe/ /'di phyi'i don du phyag mchod dang*/ /skor ba sogs la rab 'bad pas/ /lus las rngul dag byung ba yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po smad pa'i cha ni/ zang zing 'byor ba thabs kyis sdung*/ /'khor rnams lto gos nor gyis skyong*/ /mal stan 'jam la rtag bsten pa/ /bla chen 'di ni khyod kyi skyabs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa bstod pa'i cha ni/ thos pa'i ched du lus sems brel/ /bzlas brjod dka' thub drag po spyod/ /bslab dral chad 'bebs dkor mi ster/ /bka' bkyon bla ma 'di bsten dka'/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni/ byang sems 'dul ba 'dzin zhabs kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus gsum 'phrin las ni/ /'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*/ /phyag rdor sgrol ma'i de rnams bsdus/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po dngos thob kyi dga' ba'i rgyan ni/ dri med lung dang rigs tshogs kyis/ /gtan phab gzhan du mi 'gyur ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad kun/ /mthong thos sngon med dga' ba skyes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa gzugs brnyan gyi dga' ba ni/ rgyal ba'i sku dngos rang cag gi /mig gi yul las 'das gyur kyang*/ /de 'dra'i sku brnyan mthong tsam gyis/ /yid la dga' ba ci yang rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan la brgyad las/ dang po dga' ba'i 'gyur ba sgeg pa'i nyams ni/ bu sdug gcig pa thag ring por/ /song nas ring lon 'byor ldan du/ /rang gi khyim du slar 'khor bas/ /rmad byung dga' bas lus sems brtas/ /zhes pa lta bu ste lus sgeg pa dang sems dga' spro che bar ston pa'o/

/gnyis pa drag shul gyi nyams ni/ pha rol rgol ngan dgra yi dpung*/ /'joms phyir dmag dpung go bgos shing*/ /rno ba'i mtshon thogs rgyob sod kyi/ /sgra chen gnam sa ma lus khyab/ ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa dpa' ba'i nyams ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du ma byon zhing*/ /rgya gar paṇa chen ma bsten kyang*/ /'phags yul mkhas grub mtha' dag gi /gzhung don kun mkhyen rje bla ma/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa snying rje'i nyams ni/ /tshad ldan bla ma mi bsten cing*/ /dbang bskur ma thob bsnyen pa med/ /dam tshig mi srung cho ga la/ /'jug dang dbul phongs snying rje'i gnas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa mi sdug pa'i nyams ni/ mi gtsang gang ba'i ljan ljin nang*/ /lus zhugs dri ngan tshogs kyis bgos/ /gsang gnas gsal mthong gos hrul gyon/ /skyugs bro yid mug skye ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa bzhad gad kyi nyams ni/ 'dod pa'i nyon mongs spangs zer zhing*/ /'khor bar yid 'byung smra ba khyod/ /spyan zur mdze ma'i gdong nyid la/ /zug pa 'di la gad mo 'chor/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bdun pa phul byung gi nyams ni/ 'jal dbyangs mgrin par chags pa las/ /zab rgyas gsung rab mtha' dag gi /tshig don ma lus thugs chud pa/ /gang de e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad/ /ces pa lta bu/ brgyad pa 'jigs rung gi nyams ni/ smra ba'i dbang phyug chos grags kyis/ /mu stegs smra ngan mtha' dag kyang*/ /rigs pas tshar bcad rgyal bstan la/ /bcug bas 'ga' zhig skrag nas bros/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ khro bo'i nyams dang yang sbyar chog/༈ bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can gyi rgyan ni/ kho bo'i drung du khyed cag rnams/ /rgol bar 'dod nas lhag pa legs/ /lung rigs 'brel ba'i gtam dag gis/ /dogs gnas mtha' dag bsal bar bya/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ /nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan la mi 'dra ba zhig yod kyang 'dir/ dgos don sgrub pa'i grogs mched dag/tshul der 'bad mdzad kho cag phyir/

/bya ba zhig gi ched song ste/ /slar yang myur du 'ong bar bya/ /zhes pa lta bu ste rang gzhan gyi bya ba chab gsang byed dgos pa lta bu bsdu'o/ /༈ nyer gcig pa kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ dpyid dus zhing pas sa bon tshogs/ /btab pas myu gu mthong ba'i dus/ /than pas gdung nas phongs pa'i tshe/ /char chen babs pas dga' ba skyes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba la gnyis las/ dang po bsam pa rgya che ba ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nus mngon sum du/ /rgol ba mdzad kyang 'gog nus pa'i/ /rgyal ba gnyis pas 'khrul ldan lugs/ /'ga' zhig btang snyoms nyid du bzhag /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa 'byor ba rgya che ba ni/ rin chen las grub gzhal med dbus/ /gdong lngas btegs pa'i khrir 'gying zhing*/ /nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur ba/ /ngal so'i bu de srid na brjid/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /༈ nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor gyi rgyan la gsum las/ dang po chos la bsnyon pa ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i rgyan min te/ /mkhas dbang yongs kyi spobs pa mchog /'phrog mdzad chom rkun nyid du nges/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa yul la bsnyon pa ni/ sos ka'i zla ba'i 'od bsil yang*/ /las bsags yi dwags 'ga' zhig gi /lus la reg bya tsha ba'i dngos/ /bzod dka' ster ba nyid du snang*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa rang bzhin la bsnyon pa ni/ gangs kyi ri yi kha dog ni/ /rang bzhin dkar ba nyid min gyi/ /rdo thal ga bur khu ba yis/ /legs par byugs pa nyid du gsal/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan la gnyis dang bdun/ dang po la'ang gnyis kyi/ dang po tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ mdzes shing dkar ba yid du 'ong*/ /gdung ba sel zhing yid dga' bskyed/ /tshim byed bdud rtsi ci yang sbro/ /'dod pa'i re ba rgyas par byed/ /ces pa lta bu ste dbyangs can ma dang zla ba sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa tha dad tshig 'dra ba'i sbyar ba ni/

bya ba dus las yol med cing*/ /'dod don du ma 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gting mtha'i tshad kyang gzhal dka' bar/ /skye bo du ma'i gtam las sgrog /ces pa lta bu ste sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las dang yon tan mang du 'byung ba dang*/ mkhyen pa'i tshad dang de mkhas pa'i gtam las 'byung ba rnams rgya mtsho'i khyad par dang sbyar ba'o/ /gnyis pa la bdun las/ dang po bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ mthong byed yul du mdzes par snang*/ /bltas tshe yid la tshim pa med/ /dkar 'jam dung gi reg bya dang*/ /kha dog gis kyang yid dga' bskyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa bya ba 'gal ba min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ yid la dga' ba'i dpal ster zhing*/ /rab dkar lang tsho rgyas pa can/ /zla 'od 'khyud pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mtsho byung ma la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa 'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar ba ni/ mgo skyes nag snum rnam par ldem/ /dkar mdzes zla ba tshes pas brgyan/ /blo ldan drag pos rnam dpyod dang*/ /dbyangs can ngag gi dpal ster mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa nges pa can gyi sbyar ba ni/ mgon khyod dgyes dgur spyod pa ni/ /chos tshul yin gyi 'dod phyir min/ /thabs kyis 'khrid 'di dge don la/ /bskul phyir yin gyi gzhan du min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba ni/ 'od dkar can gyi dkyil 'khor 'dis/ /kunda'i tshal rnams rgyas mod de/ /'on kyang gnyis skyes du ma zhig / dga' ba'i rnam pa ci yang byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ drug pa 'gal med kyi sbyar ba ni/ lha yi bla ma spyan stong ldan/ /skyes rgu'i bdag pos mchod sbyin len/ /mig gsum ldan pas phas rgol 'joms/ /gnyis skyes dbang pos 'od dkar 'gyed/ /ces pa lta bu ste sbyar chos spyan stong sogs rang rang la ldan pa mi 'gal ba'o/ /bdun pa 'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba ni/ gzhon yang rgyal ba'i yab tu gyur/ /ral gri 'phyar yang 'jigs pa bral/

/glegs bam 'dzin yang mi mkhyen med/ /'gying bag ldan yang nga rgyal bral/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan la lnga las/ dang po yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par ni/ 'gro la sku yi rnam 'gyur te/ /gsung gis dam pa'i chos dag dang*/ /thugs kyis mkhyen gzigs mi ldan yang*/ /gdul bya rjes 'dzin sku brnyan rnams/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa rigs ma tshang ba ni/ rkang 'thung rigs las ma skyes shing*/ /yal ga lo 'dab mi ldan yang*/ /mnyen lcugs phra ldem dri ngad ldang*/ /utpal mig can lus yid 'ong*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa bya ba ma tshang ba ni/ khro gnyer dpral bar ma bsdus shing*/ /zhal gyi mche ba ma gtsigs par/ /ma lus bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs rnams/ /'joms mdzad rgyal ba de la 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa rdzas ma tshang ba ni/ /byang chub shing drung bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /mda' mtshon go cha sogs med par/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i bdud kyi dpung*/ /pham mdzad shākya'i rgyal po nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ lnga pa rgyu'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ 'dod dgu'i yo byad ma bsags shing*/ /gzhan la phan 'dod sems med kyang*/ /rgyal mtshan rtser btags mchod gsol bas/ /ci 'dod re skong yid bzhin nor/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan la gnyis las/ dang po bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis rnams/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'dzin cing sa steng kun khyab par/ /sbel la mtshungs pa nyid ces grags/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/ mdog dkar 'dzes pa'i glang rgan dang*/ /thos pa med pa'i blun po mtshungs/ /sdong dum gos ser g.yogs pa dang*/ /tshul khrims bral ba'i btsun gzugs mtshungs/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan la drug las/ dang po gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba ni/ dpyid mthar than pas gdung ba'i tshe/ /mkha' la char sbrin 'khrigs pa la/

/zhing pa'i tshogs rnams dgar 'gyur zhing*/ /lam 'gron dag la gdung ba skyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa gzhi gcig gi byed pa 'gal ba ni/ sgyu ma mkhan sprul rta glang sogs/ /rtsed 'jor byed par rgyus ldan dag /dngos min snang ltar med shes shing*/ /gzhan ni bden 'dzin la mtshan byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa gzhi gcig gi chos du ma 'gal ba ni/ bzhin ras dkar la skra tshogs nag /na tshod gzhon yang blo gros rgan/ /nor gyis phongs kyang thos pas phyug /lag len mkhas kyang 'gro don chung*/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa rdzas 'gal ba ni/ zla ba'i gdong la utpal mig /dung gi so la byu ru'i mchu/ /pi wang 'dzin cing glu dbyangs len/ /rgyal yum gzhon nu dbyangs can ma/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa gzhi gcig gi las 'gal ba ni/ skal ldan 'gro rnams thar lam la/ /'khrid mdzad rgyal ba gnyis pa des/ /phyogs ris med kyang gzhan phyogs kyi/ /grub mtha' bkag nas mi 'dod ster/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa sbyar ba'i 'gal pa ni/ dri ma dang bral rab tu dkar/ /rnam par bkra zhing 'od zer 'phro/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab kha cig la/ /phan 'gyur la lar gnod pa ster/ zhes pa lta bu ste zla bas kunda la phan cing padma la gnod pa dang sbyar zhing*/ dbyangs can dang sbyar na skal ldan dang sdang ba la phan gnod byed pa dang sbyar ro/ /༈ nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa ni/ /dpon gyi bya ba khral la sogs/ /mi 'bab zhing las so nom med/ /nor la 'tsho skyong mi dgos pa'i/ / dbul phongs bya bral 'di dag bde/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan la gsum las/ dang po/ mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i zol bstod ni/ dmag dpung ma bsgul lung tsam gyis/ /the rong mang po skrag mdzad na/ /rgya chen g.yul gyi dpung gshoms tshe/ /'joms la som nyi ci zhig yod/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa dpa' ba phun tshogs ni/ bsod nams stobs ldan 'khor los bsgyur/

/nga las nu khyod lha dbang gi /mnga' thang gling bzhir bcas pa la/ /ci dgar spyod 'di rigs sam ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa stobs phun tshogs kyi zol bstod ni/ rab mang mnga' 'bangs tshogs kun la/ /dbang bsgyur dgra sde'i dpung rnams 'joms/ /dregs ldan kun gyi gtsug rgyan du/ /gyur 'dis sa skyong khyod la ci/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ sum cu pa nges bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po mchog gi nges bstan ni/ rab dwangs gsal ba'i me long ngos/ /gzugs brnyan cig car 'char ba 'dis/ /ji snyed shes bya ma lus pa/ /cig car kun mkhyen yul gyur ston/ / zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa mchog min gyi nges bstan ni/ rta bdun can de shar ba'i tshe/ /me 'khyer rgyu skar 'od nyams pas/ /mkhas dbang 'jig rten byon pa na/ /mi mkhas blun chos 'joms par shes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa la gsum las/ dang po yon tan lhan cig brjod pa ni/ /'jam dbyangs phyag mtshan ral gri dang*/ /lhan cig kho bo'i shes rab rno/ /dbyangs can phyag gi rgyud mang dang*/ /lhan cig kho bo'i grags snyan rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/ smin legs dkar ba'i bzhin ras kyis/ 'dod ldan sred pa rgyas pa dang*/ /lhan cig kho bo'i 'phrin las kyang*/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i drin las rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa ni/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i mkhyen pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje byin/ / gsang bdag mthu dang nus rnams kyis/ /lhan cig yid la dga' ba ster/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug bstan dar ba'i/ /legs bshad dpe 'dzin sbyangs skyor mthus/ /bdag blo'i rmongs pa'i yid 'phrog nas/ /gzhung don rtogs pa'i blo gros rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ / ༈ so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan ni/ yab gcig zur phung lnga ldan dang*/

/rgyal yum tshangs sras lha mo yis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul rnams la/ /rnam dpyod rgyas pa'i shis pa stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /༈ so bzhi pa rab sbel gyi rgyan ni/ mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i gsung*/ /zab yangs rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' ba/ /thub dbang go'u tam las gzhan su/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ ༈ /so lnga pa dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/ me long lta bu'i me long ma'i/ /dgongs pa 'grel ba'i dgongs gsal 'di/ /gzhan phan ched du gzhan 'dod ltar/ /rang gis shes tsam rang gis bris/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar dper brjod bgyis pa rnams ni rtsa ba nas 'byung ba'i go rim ltar yin yang*/ /dbye ba dang sa bcad re gnyis la dbye bsdu byas shing*/ dpe brjod rnams 'grel ba nas 'byung ba dang bstun nas tshig sbyor rang blor gang shar gyi tshul du go bder bkod de/ skabs 'dir rtsa 'grel gnyis las rang bzhin gyi rgyan lta bu ma gtogs rgyan phal cher la 'khyog po'i rgyan gyi tha snyad mdzad de/ rab rtog gi rgyan dang bsnyon dor lta bu ni 'khyog po'i rgyan dngos so/ /spyir sngon gyi slob dpon bha ra ta dang*/ rā ma ya na dang*/ gzhon nu 'byung ba dang*/ rā ma sharma sogs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan dngags kyi bstan chos che ba du ma yod cing*/ slob dpon daṇḍis de dag las btus nas bsdus te me long ma mdzad do// //
